summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration 10: (A) MARGINE CHIARO on recipe cards and (B) FORNO NEL PIANO bake suggestions in 'Quando infornare', plus regression of costing dialog, weekly plan, impasti schedule, oven CRUD, announcements CRUD, AI chat, photo tab, language switch and bio text. Seeded 3 personal recipes + 2 oven profiles via API, verified in UI, all cleaned up afterwards. Both new features work correctly with exact expected numbers; only one cosmetic issue found (green chip background class not generated by Tailwind).

issues: Class bg-[#6B8E62]/12 is NOT generated by Tailwind 3.4 (12 is not in the default opacity scale), so profitable chips render with a transparent background while the loss case (bg-[#B4442A]/10) shows its red tint. Computed backgroundColor = rgba(0,0,0,0). Fix: use bg-[#6B8E62]/10 or bg-[#6B8E62]/[12%]. Text colour green/red works correctly.
On 390px mobile the chip top row ('Costo a pezzo: € 0.12' vs 'Prezzo di vendita consigliato: € 0.30') wraps into a cramped 2-line block; consider stacking or shortening the sell label.
Translation key cost_margin (IT 'Margine' / DE 'Marge') was added but is never used anywhere; the margin % is rendered under the cost_profit label only. Dead key or missing label.

action_items: Replace bg-[#6B8E62]/12 with bg-[#6B8E62]/10 (or /[12%]) in RecipeList.jsx so the profitable margin chip actually shows the green background.
Optional: use the unused cost_margin translation key (e.g. label the % part) or remove it.
Optional: improve wrapping of the cost/sell row on narrow screens.
critical_code_review_comments: bakeSuggest keyword order: 'pane' branch is after 'panin' so 'Panini' correctly matches 220/15; verified live. Note 'pane' also matches names containing 'pane...' generically (fallback 230/30 for unknown names) - acceptable.

RecipeList margin math verified: perPiece=total/pieces, sell=perPiece*(1+markup/100), profit=sell-perPiece, margin=(profit/sell)*100; guarded for total<=0 / pieces<=0 and missing costing (no chip, no crash).
seed_data_creation: Created via API and DELETED after tests: personal recipes TEST_Baguette Prova (flour 1000g, flour €1.2/kg, 10 pcs, markup 150), TEST_Panini Prova (markup 0), TEST_Pane Prova (no costing); oven profiles TEST_Forno Ventilato (ventilato) and TEST_Forno Statico. Also created+deleted via UI: TEST_Focaccia UI recipe, TEST_Oven UI profile, TEST_Avviso QA announcement, one weekly-plan row (weekly-plan back to empty).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified live: MARGINE chip -> Baguette (1000g flour @1.2/kg, 10 pcs, markup 150) shows cost 0.12 / sell 0.30 / margin '€ 0.18 · 60%' in green text rgb(77,107,69); markup 0 recipe shows '€ 0.00 · 0%' in red rgb(180,68,42) with red chip bg; recipe without costing renders no chip. FORNO NEL PIANO -> static defaults confirmed (baguette 240°C/20', pane 235°C/40', panini 220°C/15', label '(Statico)' when no oven selected); after selecting a 'ventilato' oven the same rows became 220/18, 215/36, 200/14 with '(Ventilato con carrello)'. DE switch renders '🔥 Empfohlenes Backen: ...'. Playwright tip: the oven/recipe <select> options contain injected dev spans, so select_option(label=...) fails - use option value (read via evaluate on el.options). Announcements live under sa-tutto-tab-stoccarda; recipe grams field testid is recipe-flour_grams-input (recipe-flour-input is the flour TYPE text field). Ovens API path is /api/oven-profiles.
rca_of_the_issue: Green chip background missing: Tailwind 3.4 only generates opacity modifiers from the configured opacity scale (0,5,10,20,...) or explicit arbitrary values like /[12%]; '/12' produces no utility, so the profitable chip has no background colour while the red /10 variant works.
